description: Service-to-service (client credentials) app for Apex Business Central manufacturing setup scripts.

applicationPermissions.purpose: Access Business Central APIs and web services (v2.0 and custom APIs).
Access Business Central automation APIs for company setup.

notes: Do not assign the SUPER permission set to an Entra application.
Grant Consent from the Microsoft Entra Applications card if admin consent was not granted in Entra.
Map Application (client) ID from Entra into BC_CLIENT_ID in .env.

envMapping.BC_TENANT_ID: Directory (tenant) ID from the app Overview page
envMapping.BC_CLIENT_ID: Application (client) ID from the app Overview page
envMapping.BC_CLIENT_SECRET: Client secret Value shown once at creation time
envMapping.BC_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: Business Central environment name (for example sandbox)
